text:
I decided to go with this clinic for 150,000 baht. I consulted with a doctor who said they would perform the procedure themselves, but then:
1. They changed the person performing the procedure: During the procedure, I was told to keep my head down (during hair removal) and my eyes were "covered" (during hair transplantation), allegedly to prevent water splashing. This prevented me from seeing the person actually performing the procedure. In short, the "Pavicon Academy team" primarily performed both the hair removal and transplantation. When I asked the doctor about it, I was told, "I can't do it alone, we need help."
2. Before the procedure, they said they would only shave a "small" portion of the hair on the back of my head, but as you can see in the picture, it's about the size of my palm 😢
3. The price did not include blood tests or aftercare shampoo/spray; these had to be purchased separately.
In summary: I feel like they withheld information, didn't tell me everything, and misled me during crucial steps. I've completely lost trust in them. I'm extremely disappointed and heartbroken. I will never use their services again. I recommend anyone considering this procedure to check the terms and conditions and confirm the identity of the person performing the procedure beforehand.
